title: Piggy Bank and Safe (personal storage shared across the world)
player_outcome: Buy a Piggy Bank from the Merchant (and later a Safe from the Mechanic): opening any of your piggy banks shows the same 40 slots you carry with your character, and shops take coins stored there.
design: Verified: no piggy/safe anywhere; only wooden and gold chests are containers.
TileObjectDef.SharedStorage ('piggy_bank' | 'safe') with interaction Chest; no container slots on the instance.
PlayerState.Banks: Dictionary<string, Inventory> (40 slots each), created on demand. PlayerSave.Banks keeps the slot lists.

ObjectInteraction Chest: for SharedStorage, raise ContainerOpened with the player's bank Inventory. Change the event to (PlayerEntity, TileObjectInstance, Inventory); normal chests pass new Inventory(obj.Container).
InventoryScreen opens whatever Inventory the event carries (small change; P2 overlap).
Breaking a shared-storage object never spills contents (they live on the character).
Coins.Total/Wallet include banks when paying at shops (Terraria 1.4 behaviour).
Assets: piggy_bank (pig) and safe (box with dial and handle) generators in bgen/items_misc.py or furniture.py; assets.json objects entries.
files_modify: data/town_residents.json — mechanic sells safe after defeated_skeletron (verify the Terraria seller)
data_changes: Tile objects piggy_bank {size [2,2,2], interaction chest, sharedStorage piggy_bank, itemValue 10000} and safe {sharedStorage safe, itemValue 200000}; shop entries
tests: PersonalStorageTests: store 10 dirt via one piggy bank, open another → same contents; save round-trip; breaking the bank drops only the bank item
PersonalStorageTests: buying pays from coins in the piggy bank
risks: The ContainerOpened signature change touches the UI and tests.
